summary_md: **Zenlyte ([@Z3nlyte](https://x.com/Z3nlyte/status/2116317079083131272))** notes NVIDIA's **NemoClaw** blueprints, which bundle a tuned harness, Nemotron and an OpenShell policy sandbox for OpenClaw, Hermes and LangChain Deep Agents. NVIDIA claims near-frontier results at about 10x lower cost per run with Nemotron 3 Ultra ([NVIDIA/NemoClaw](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw)).
